name: Notification
description: A status message card with a tone icon or an avatar, a timestamp, body text and optional actions.

props.name: title
props.description: What happened, in a few words. Names the card.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colours the round tile and picks its icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the tone's icon inside the tile.

props.name: avatar
props.description: An image URL or an Avatar, shown instead of the tile. Use a 40 pixel avatar.

props.name: time
props.description: A short timestamp after the title, e.g. "2 min ago".

props.name: actions
props.description: Small buttons under the body, e.g. a secondary and a brand Button with size="sm".

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button in the top corner and is called when it is pressed.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the close button.

props.name: unread
props.description: Shows a water dot beside the icon and tells screen readers the card is unread.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Also accepts every other article prop.
